ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO:

SECTION 1, The Chicago Zoning Ordinance is amended by changing all of the C1-1,
Neighborhood Commercial, RT-3.5 Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse and Multi-Unit, B1-3
Neighborhood Shopping Districts symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 19-G in
the area bounded by:

North Rogers Avenue; the alley next west of and parallel to North Sheridan Road, West
Howard Street; a line 266 feet west of and parallel to West Howard Street; the alley next
south of and parallel to West Howard Street,

to those of a B2-3, Neighborhood Mixed-Use District.
SECTION 2. This ordinance shall be effective after its passage and publication.

WAL

Maria E. Hadden
Alderman, 49" Ward

Common Addresses:
7555-7559 N. Rogers Avenue
7518-7532 N. Greenview Avenue
1441-1427 W. Howard Street
7601- 7627 N. Rogers Avenue
